tasks.commit: This record is included in MAESTRO: persist Pianola agent and group selection

contract.registry: Existing {targets:[...]} supervisor envelope and kind=watch-scope; retain scope UUID, enabled, createdAt, cadence and required managerAgentId. No global or hardcoded manager.

selection.label: Nonblank display label, max 200 characters
selection.agentIds: Required array of opaque native agent IDs
selection.groupIds: Required array of actual native group IDs
selection.excludedAgentIds: Required array of explicitly excluded native agent IDs

contract.validation: ID lists are deduplicated, at most 500 entries each, nonblank strings at most 200 characters. At least one agent/group must be selected. New selection rejects legacy projectRoots/ownerRoots/includeWorktrees fields; mixed old/new schemas are invalid.
contract.membership: Resolve each current/future tab by its agentId. Any selected agent or native group on its parentSessionId ancestry includes that agent and all descendants. No cwd/root/name matching; a direct agent selection survives group moves. Resolve the whole ancestry with missing/cyclic/over-100-depth, remote or Pianola-manager nodes denied.
contract.groupMetadata: PianolaScopeOwner.groupId is the native Session.groupId. null explicitly means ungrouped; undefined means unavailable. When any ID-based group selection exists, group metadata must be known along the affected lineage to prevent bypassing paused overlapping groups. Incomplete unrelated owners do not suppress other agents.
contract.ownership: Manager IDs and explicit agent exclusions from persisted scopes veto automatic membership, including their descendant lineage. Paused/consult/ephemeral tabs and unavailable/remote/Pianola owners are ineligible. A disabled matching legacy tab watch vetoes scope enrollment; enabled explicit tab watches retain priority. Any matching disabled ID scope vetoes automatic coverage. Remaining overlaps choose one scope by createdAt then scope ID.
contract.migration: Legacy project/agents selections remain validated, readable and writable with their prior fields, exclusions and enabled state. Existing watch/orchestrate records are unchanged. Legacy path scopes remain suspended by the cycle with an explicit reconfiguration issue; never infer whole-agent consent from directories. Replacing a legacy selection with explicit IDs changes the consent/binding fingerprint and baselines existing tabs.
contract.checkpoint: Configuration fingerprint covers manager, mode and sorted ID/exclusion sets. Binding fingerprint covers owner/ancestor identities and eligibility, independent of cwd/group moves that remain selected. A lineage/owner change requires a fresh baseline; existing dedup and unresolved-delivery state stay in the cycle.

tasks.commit: This record is included in MAESTRO: wire native Pianola scope workers and guarded admission

contract.productionCallChain: Existing createPianolaLifecycle -> supervisor start/reconcile -> one pianola watch-scope <scope-id> child per persisted enabled selection -> registered CLI action -> createPianolaScopeWorkerDeps -> runPianolaScopeCycle. Legacy path scopes report an explicit reconfiguration failure instead of falling through to orchestration.
contract.discovery: Each native session census includes every current owner, groupId (string or null), parentSessionId and open AI tab. Polling discovers new tabs/agents and membership/lineage changes without per-tab processes or per-poll inference. Existing explicit watches are retained; future legacy Auto-Watch does not override a matching scope, disabled scope or exclusion.
contract.scheduling: At most 20 changed, ready tabs per serial worker cycle; persisted nextTabIndex rotates over the native census to avoid starvation by failing/active prefixes. Unavailable tab cursors are isolated even on enrollment. Metadata/checkpoint corruption fails closed; native supervisor restart/backoff and health remain in use.
contract.baselineAndRecovery: Existing tab checkpoints are committed before work. Old/new enrollment, ancestry/config binding, paused tabs and ownership changes use existing baseline/dedup logic. A stream busy on enrollment is checked after completion under its original message ID, including unchanged final text. Full transcript fetch plus cursor/identity checks preserves current-turn risk. Scope disable/Encore-off suspends its checkpoint; worker persistence preserves host suspension and admitted intents. Restart after a crash restores durable state.
contract.guardedSend: Worker uses dedicated pianola_scope_reply, with no send_command fallback. Native authenticated CLI admission rechecks Encore, current owner/membership/paused/busy state, configuration/binding, exact recipient/cursor, persisted unresolved intent and current rule/answer. It appends deliveryStatus=admitted to the existing audit and claims the checkpoint before invoking the ordinary renderer send path with an explicit tab, background=true, no force/queue, and requireDeliveryReceipt=true.
contract.deliverySafety: Optional audit deliveryStatus=admitted and checkpoint unresolvedIntent.admitted are backward compatible. The native claim prevents duplicate answers for the same agent/tab/message across overlapping requests. A definitive renderer rejection permits the existing bounded retry; a timeout/malformed receipt/disconnect is unknown and leaves intent/audit claim in place without blind retry. Legacy dispatch receipt behavior is unchanged.
contract.nextDecisionSeam: This increment composes rule answers and existing human escalation only. V2-04 must wire Mira judgment, guarded manager completion and persisted actor/next-action lifecycle; it must reuse native admission and retain unknown-delivery state. The configured manager comes from the selection; no globally hardcoded manager or live configuration was added.
